LanguageData.CA_Rec1: An alert on the right when something important waits
LanguageData.CA_Rec2: A short plan for the day every morning at 7:00
LanguageData.CA_Rec3: Open the advisor any time with the button at the bottom or F9
LanguageData.CA_ShowAlert_Desc: An alert on the right side of the screen when something urgent or important waits. Click it to open the advisor.
LanguageData.CA_AlertTips_Desc: Normally the alert shows only urgent and important things. With this on it also shows plain tips, so it is nearly always visible.
LanguageData.CA_Morning: Plan for the day every morning
LanguageData.CA_Morning_Desc: At 7:00 the three most important things for today and the next step to your goal.
LanguageData.CA_MorningLetter_Desc: A letter on the right (stays until you read it) instead of a short message at the top.
LanguageData.CA_Morning_Calm: Nothing urgent. A good day to build and research.
LanguageData.CA_ScoreTip: Colony score 0–100: food, mood, health, safety and progress. Every urgent problem takes 5 points.
LanguageData.CA_Head: Colonists {0} · food for {1} days · medicine {2} · fighters {3} · strength {4}/3
LanguageData.CA_Now_Sub: The most important first. Red: right now. Orange: soon. Grey: a good idea.
LanguageData.CA_Now_AllGood: All is fine. Look at "Way to the end" for the next big step.
LanguageData.CA_Make_Sub: What the colony is short of. "Add bill" puts a bill on the right workbench that makes them until you have enough.
LanguageData.CA_Make_NoRecipe: can't be made yet (research or buy it)
LanguageData.CA_N_Meals: about a day and a half of meals for {0} colonists
LanguageData.CA_N_Parka: winter here gets to {0} – everyone needs warm clothes
LanguageData.CA_N_Clothes: {0} with torn clothes, {1} without a shirt (bad mood)
LanguageData.CA_N_Components: components are needed for almost every advanced building
LanguageData.CA_Res_None: Nothing is being researched! Pick something below.
LanguageData.CA_R_Electricity: Power is the key to almost everything: lights, coolers, turrets, better workbenches.
LanguageData.CA_R_Batteries: Stores power for the night and windless days.
LanguageData.CA_R_Cooling: A cooler makes a freezer – food lasts for months instead of days.
LanguageData.CA_R_PassiveCooler: Cooling without power for hot days.
LanguageData.CA_R_Stonecutting: Stone blocks: walls that don't burn.
LanguageData.CA_R_Furniture: Better furniture: dressers, end tables, better rooms and mood.
LanguageData.CA_R_Smithing: Smithy: melee weapons and the way to machining.
LanguageData.CA_R_Clothing: Parkas and dusters – needed in cold or hot climate.
LanguageData.CA_R_Psychoid: Psychite tea, a cheap mood boost.
LanguageData.CA_R_Watermill: A watermill gives steady power if you have a river.
LanguageData.CA_R_Paste: Nutrient paste: lots of food from little, no cook needed.
LanguageData.CA_R_Hydroponics: Indoor crops all year – essential in cold biomes.
LanguageData.CA_R_Survival: Survival meals for caravans and emergencies.
LanguageData.CA_R_Micro: Microelectronics opens comms console, hospital beds and most of the tech tree.
LanguageData.CA_R_Machining: Machining table: guns, armor, bionics later.
LanguageData.CA_R_Guns: Gunsmithing: real guns for your fighters.
LanguageData.CA_R_Turrets: Turrets defend the base even when colonists sleep.
LanguageData.CA_R_Mortars: Mortars break sieges from far away.
LanguageData.CA_R_Drugs: Drug lab: the way to making medicine.
LanguageData.CA_R_Medicine: Make your own medicine – you are short of it.
LanguageData.CA_R_Fabrication: Components yourself – needed for everything advanced and for the ship.
LanguageData.CA_R_MultiAnalyzer: Multi-analyzer unlocks the late research (needed for the ship).
LanguageData.CA_R_Flak: Flak armor – your fighters survive much more.
LanguageData.CA_R_Geothermal: Geothermal: lots of steady power from a steam geyser.
LanguageData.CA_R_Pods: Transport pods: quick trips, trade and quests far away.
LanguageData.CA_R_Ship: The spaceship – the classic way to win the game.
LanguageData.CA_R_Refining: Chemfuel for generators and later the ship.
LanguageData.CA_T_EnemiesD: Drafted {0} of {1} fighters. Draft them, fight behind cover and keep the wounded away.
LanguageData.CA_T_FireD: Firefighting needs someone with firefighting on – or draft colonists and put it out by hand.
LanguageData.CA_T_DownedD: Down – carry to a bed and tend.
LanguageData.CA_T_ColdD: Hypothermia. Get them into a warm room, give warm clothes, build a heater or campfire.
LanguageData.CA_T_HotD: Heatstroke. Get them into a cool room, build a cooler or passive cooler.
LanguageData.CA_T_StarvingD: No food reaches them. Check food, cooks and stockpiles.
LanguageData.CA_T_BreakD: Give them recreation and rest, good food, a nice room. Drugs or a party help quickly.
LanguageData.CA_T_MoodD: Look at their needs and thoughts – fix the biggest bad thought.
LanguageData.CA_T_FoodLowD: Hunt animals, harvest what is ripe, gather berries, buy from traders.
LanguageData.CA_T_FoodSomeD: Plant more crops (rice is fast, corn lasts), hunt and build a freezer.
LanguageData.CA_T_NoMedsD: Tending without medicine is weak. Buy medicine, grow healroot or research medicine production.
LanguageData.CA_T_FewMedsD: Keep at least {0} for the next raid or sickness.
LanguageData.CA_T_FreezerD: A closed room with a cooler below 0° keeps food for months.
LanguageData.CA_W_Cooking: No meals – colonists eat raw food and get a bad mood (and food poisoning).
LanguageData.CA_W_Doctor: Nobody tends the wounded. Wounds get infected.
LanguageData.CA_W_Hauling: Things stay lying around and rot.
LanguageData.CA_W_Growing: Fields are not sown or harvested.
LanguageData.CA_T_NoBedD: Sleeping on the ground gives a bad mood. Build beds (a bedroom each is best).
LanguageData.CA_T_BedOutsideD: Sleeping outside: bad mood, cold and rain. Build walls and a roof.
LanguageData.CA_T_PowerD: Not enough power. Build more generators or batteries, or turn off what you don't need.
LanguageData.CA_T_DefenceD: Raids get bigger. Build sandbags and walls at the entrance, later turrets.
LanguageData.CA_T_UnarmedD: Make or buy weapons (see "Make"), or pick them up after a raid.
LanguageData.CA_Goal_Sub: Four stages to a strong colony, then the end of the game. Hover a step for help. Pick your ending – the advisor then shows its next step everywhere.
LanguageData.CA_Q_Sub: Rated by danger (stars) against your strength ({0}/3: fighters, weapons, armor, turrets) and by reward.
LanguageData.CA_Q_None: No quests on offer right now.
LanguageData.CA_Q_Ok: Danger {0}, your strength {1} – you can handle it.
LanguageData.CA_Q_Maybe: Danger {0}, your strength {1} – possible with good preparation (cover, medicine, all fighters).
LanguageData.CA_Q_No: Danger {0}, your strength {1} – too strong for you now.
LanguageData.CA_S_Survive_Goal: A roof, beds, food and a start of research.
LanguageData.CA_S_Stable_Goal: Food that lasts, power, a hospital and a first defence.
LanguageData.CA_S_Grow_Goal: More people, fields, microelectronics, trade over radio, weapons for all.
LanguageData.CA_S_Strong_Goal: Own components, late research, turrets, armor – ready for the end of the game.
LanguageData.CA_C_Beds_H: Architect → Furniture → Bed. Assign beds or let colonists pick.
LanguageData.CA_C_Roof: All beds are under a roof
LanguageData.CA_C_Roof_H: Walls around a room give it a roof automatically.
LanguageData.CA_C_Food5_H: Grow rice and potatoes, hunt, gather berries.
LanguageData.CA_C_Stove: A place to cook (campfire or stove)
LanguageData.CA_C_Stove_H: Architect → Production → Campfire / Fueled stove. Add a bill "Cook simple meal".
LanguageData.CA_C_Research_H: Build a simple research bench and pick a project.
LanguageData.CA_C_Freezer_H: A closed room with a cooler in the wall blowing in, and a stockpile for food.
LanguageData.CA_C_Power_H: Research Electricity, then wood generator, solar or wind turbine.
LanguageData.CA_C_Medicine_H: Buy from traders, grow healroot, later make your own.
LanguageData.CA_C_Hospital: A hospital bed (bed set to medical)
LanguageData.CA_C_Hospital_H: Select a bed → "Medical". A clean room near the base is best.
LanguageData.CA_C_Defence_H: Sandbags at the entrance give cover. Later mini-turrets.
LanguageData.CA_C_Six_H: Take prisoners after raids and recruit them, accept refugees, buy slaves.
LanguageData.CA_C_Fields_H: Zone → Growing zone on good soil.
LanguageData.CA_C_Micro_H: Opens comms console and hi-tech research bench.
LanguageData.CA_C_Comms_H: Call traders, talk to factions – many quests come from here.
LanguageData.CA_C_Fabrication_H: Fabrication bench: components and advanced components.
LanguageData.CA_C_MultiAnalyzer_H: Build it next to the hi-tech research bench.
LanguageData.CA_C_Turrets_H: Turrets behind sandbags at the entrance, with power.
LanguageData.CA_C_Armor: Half of the fighters wear armor
LanguageData.CA_C_Armor_H: Flak vest and helmet at the machining table.
LanguageData.CA_C_Wealth_H: Wealth makes raids bigger – but the late game needs it.
LanguageData.CA_E_Ship_D: Build a ship and fly away. After the reactor starts, raids come for about 15 days – then launch.
LanguageData.CA_E_Journey_D: A quest tells you about an old ship far away. Travel there with a caravan, start it and defend it until it launches.
LanguageData.CA_E_Royal_D: Earn titles from the Empire. When a high title is reached a quest brings the High Stellarch – host and protect them, then leave with the Empire.
LanguageData.CA_E_Archonexus_D: With great wealth an archotech offers a deal: sell the colony and move three times, then wake the archonexus core.
LanguageData.CA_E_Void_D: Study the void monolith and its horrors, raise its level and finally face the void.
LanguageData.CA_E_Gravship_D: Build a gravship around a grav engine, travel the world and to orbit, and take on the mechhive.
LanguageData.CA_ES_ShipBase_H: The base of all ship research.
LanguageData.CA_ES_ShipFab_H: Ship parts need advanced components and late research.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Components_H: The ship needs lots of components, advanced components, plasteel and uranium.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Hull_H: One casket for every colonist who should leave.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Core_H: The computer core is often bought from traders or found.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Reactor_H: Build it last: once started, raids come until launch. Prepare defences first!
LanguageData.CA_ES_Launch: Start the reactor, survive and launch
LanguageData.CA_ES_Launch_H: About 15 days of attacks. Turrets, mortars, all fighters.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Offer_H: It comes as a quest after some time, often after you have a comms console.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Supplies_H: Packaged survival meals or pemmican don't rot.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Arms_H: Caravans get ambushed on the way.
LanguageData.CA_ES_FindShip_H: Form a caravan (world map) and travel there.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Defend: Start it and defend until launch
LanguageData.CA_ES_Defend_H: Raids come while it powers up.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Title: A colonist with a royal title
LanguageData.CA_ES_Title_H: Do quests for the Empire and earn honor.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Throne_H: Higher titles want a throne room with fine furniture.
LanguageData.CA_ES_HighTitle_H: Keep their needs (rooms, food, music) or they get unhappy.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Ascent_H: Comes once you have a high enough title.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Stellarch: Host and protect the High Stellarch
LanguageData.CA_ES_Stellarch_H: Strong attacks come during the stay.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Wealth350_H: Then the archotech offers the deal as a quest.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Cycle2_H: Only a few colonists and items can go along. Build up again.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Cycle3_H: Grow wealthy again for the last move.
LanguageData.CA_ES_ArchCore_H: Travel to the archonexus and invoke the core.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Activate_H: Find the monolith on the map and touch it with a colonist.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Study_H: Capture entities on holding platforms and study them for dark knowledge.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Level2_H: Study enough, then activate the monolith again.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Level3_H: Stronger horrors come – keep strong defences.
LanguageData.CA_ES_VoidEnd_H: The last activation leads to the end – choose your ending there.
LanguageData.CA_ES_GravEngine_H: Found at the start of an Odyssey game or in ancient sites.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Console_H: Everything on the substructure flies with you.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Fly_H: Needs chemfuel; fly to new places for resources.
LanguageData.CA_ES_Mechhive_H: A big fight – armor, good weapons, medicine.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOn: The mod sets itself up and works right away. Ideal for new players and anyone who does not want to tweak anything.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOffSame: Custom settings. Still the same as recommended.
LanguageData.MUI_ConfirmOn: Turn recommended settings on? Your changes ({0}) will be replaced with the recommended values.
LanguageData.MUI_Locked: Detailed settings are locked. Want to change them? Turn off the switch above – your values start from the recommended ones.
LanguageData.MUI_ChangedTip: Differs from the recommended setting ({0}). Click to restore the recommended value.
LanguageData.CA_Sup_Sub: What the colony has to make for the chosen ending. Food and drugs marked "set aside" stay untouched at home – colonists, prisoners and your animals don't eat them (unless starving); guests like the High Stellarch do.
LanguageData.CA_Sup_Empty: Nothing on the list yet. Add the recommended supplies for your goal or any item you want to keep ready.
LanguageData.CA_Sup_Reserve_Tip: Colonists, prisoners and your animals won't eat or pocket it at home (only someone starving). Guests can still eat it.
LanguageData.CA_Sup_PickTitle: Add an item to the goal supplies
